name: Marcus Vance
title: Why Handheld APUs Are Hitting a Thermal Ceiling: The 25W Stagnation
pitch: A deep dive comparing the Steam Deck 2 OLED, ROG Ally X, and rumored Xbox handheld. I have collected thermal imaging and watt-to-frame efficiency charts showing how mobile silicon architecture must change before we see a true generational leap in portable PC gaming.

name: Elena Rostova
title: The AA Game Studio Survival Guide: How Mid-Budget Developers Are Outmaneuvering $200M Blockbusters
pitch: Interviews with 4 independent studio leads who kept their teams under 60 people and profitable in 2025/2026. The piece explores why smaller teams can iterate faster, maintain creative control, and out-perform bloated AAA publishers on Steam.
